sections.heading: Tips and Tricks for Different Devices
sections.body:
So you're playing 'Stickman Wingsuit 3D' on a different device? Here are a few tips and tricks to help you get the most out of the game:

Finally, for tablet devices, use the touchscreen controls to control your character. This will give you a more intuitive experience and allow you to make more complex maneuvers with ease.
